messages:
Sam: FYI cedar reported p99 jump ~2x since deploy at ~08:12 UTC. customer=cedar.health. They saw throughput drop + some timeouts. KV-cache miss rate spiked. Can runtime take a look? cc @Jess @Oliver
InfraBot: Alert: cedar-prod-serving p99 increased 2.1x (since 1841234400). KV cache miss rate +400%. Autoswitch to fallback model triggered.
Jess: On it. Sam — can you paste a trace id or sample request? any repro steps?
Sam: Support sent trace id: trace-cedar-789. Also their repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"rib-3b","input":"<long prompt>"}'
```
Support: Customer observed high latencies 08:12-08:27 UTC. They were on dedicated pool cedar-ded1. No config change on their side.
Oliver: I'll start pprof on one replica and run a short soak. Which image/tag is running there?
Sam: serving image: runtime:v2026-03-09-kernel-opt
Li: I pushed a kernel-selector tweak to canary last night and it got promoted to main around 08:10 UTC. Could be culprit — we can revert.
Jess: Can we run a synthetic bench that matches their seq len distribution? Suggested: 
```
./bench -c cedar-ded1 -m rib-3b -n 300 -s 512 --kv-warmup 200
```
Oliver: Starting that bench now against cedar-ded1. I'll capture perf map + flamegraph. If KV misses are real, check prefix cache hit ratio at /dash/kvcache/cedar-ded1
Sam: Link to logs + trace: https://internal.redwood/logs/trace-cedar-789 and dash: https://dash.redwood/alerts/1841234567
Jess: If kernel-selector is likely, let's revert on one canary node first and watch. Li — can you revert cedar-canary-2?
Li: Reverting cedar-canary-2 now. Will monitor for 10m and report p99.
InfraBot: Deploy event: revert kernel-selector on cedar-canary-2 by Li completed (1841234615).
Oliver: Quick update: after revert, short bench p99 on the canary replica fell from ~420ms -> ~190ms. Flamegraph points to extra indirection in kernel selection path causing spins.
Jess: Great signal. Sam — please let the customer know we found a regression and are rolling back; mitigation expected within ~15m. @Support pls notify.
Support: Notifying customer now, will follow up when green :thumbsup:
Sam: Assigning follow-ups: Oliver - PR + perf notes; Li - promote revert if canary stays green; Jess - postmortem draft. I'll close after green. Thanks all!
